polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of November 2026.  This month's big sale is the 11.11 mega sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
FINANCE  

Your October data shows strong momentum—revenue rose to MYR 15k while costs stayed near MYR 14k, giving a slim MYR 877 net gain. To push profit higher before year‑end, focus on three actions that directly lift margin and cash flow during the upcoming 11.11 sale window.

1. Shift as many sales as possible to your owned website (fee 2.9 % + MYR 1/order) instead of marketplaces. Right now Instagram/WhatsApp yields ~63 % profit on the satin wrap dress versus 49 % on Shopee and 54 % on TikTok. Moving just 20 extra wraps (MYR 139 each) to the site adds roughly MYR 278 profit (20 × (MYR 139 − MYR 52) × 0.63 − fees vs marketplace). Promote the site with a “free shipping over MYR 150” banner and a QR code on your pop‑up bazaar table.

2. Run a limited‑time bundle on the 11.11 flash hour (e.g., 12 pm–2 pm): satin wrap dress + silk‑touch scarf for MYR 150 (instead of MYR 178). The bundle’s combined cost is MYR 64, so even after a 9 % TikTok fee you keep ~MYR 70 profit per set versus MYR 77 selling separately. The perceived discount drives volume; aim to sell 30 bundles (MYR 2,100 revenue) which would add about MYR 1,200 extra profit compared to selling the pieces apart at full price.

3. Tighten stock on slow movers. The pleated midi skirt ties up MYR 1,472 at cost but only moved 2 units last month. List it at a 40 % discount (MYR 53.40) on Shopee/TikTok for the 11.11 sale—still above your MYR 32 cost, yielding ~MYR 15 profit each. Clearing even 15 skirts frees ~MYR 480 cash and avoids holding loss‑making inventory.

Execute these now, track daily sales by channel in a simple spreadsheet (date, platform, units, revenue), and review results after the 11.11 window to see which tactic lifted profit most. Good luck—Aina, you’ve got this! ✨

About 25 orders lost to stock-outs or packing limits. Ran out of: Satin wrap dress (12 more wanted), Linen co-ord set (9 more wanted), Tailored blazer (9 more wanted). Stock left: 58 pieces worth MYR 1,656 at cost (bought 84). Ads MYR 2,400, about MYR 74 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 1,119. Costs MYR 12k, net MYR 2,122. Cash now MYR 17k. Shop rating 4.52. This month's big sale is the 12.12 year-end sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Last month’s strong sales were held back by frequent stock‑outs—especially on high‑margin items like satin wrap dresses, linen sets, and tailored blazers—which forced you to leave potential profit on the table while still spending on ads. With cash healthy and the 12.12 sale approaching, tightening inventory and ad efficiency will lift margins fast.

1. **Re‑order top‑sellers now**: Place a purchase order for 30 satin wrap dresses (cost ≈ MYR 1,560), 20 linen co‑ord sets (MYR 1,320), and 15 tailored blazers (MYR 1,380). This covers the unmet demand from November plus a safety buffer for the 12.12 spike, adding roughly MYR 4,260 of potential profit if sold at current margins.  
2. **Cut ad waste**: Pause or lower bids on any ad set delivering >MYR 80 cost per order (based on your MYR 74 avg). Redirect ~MYR 600 of that spend to retargeting website visitors with a 10% off coupon—this channel has 0% platform fees and higher profit per order. Expect to maintain similar order volume while reducing ad cost per order to ~MYR 50, saving ~MYR 180 over the month.  
3. **Prep a website‑only 12.12 bundle**: Create a limited “Year‑End Modest Set” (one satin dress + one silk scarf) priced at MYR 150 on your site. Cost ≈ MYR 64, platform fee 2.9% + MYR 1/order → profit ≈ MYR 78 per bundle. Promote it via Instagram Stories and WhatsApp broadcasts to your 25 repeat buyers; even converting 10 of them adds MYR 780 profit with zero marketplace fees.  

Track daily stock levels and ad CPL in a simple spreadsheet so you can adjust quickly before the sale. These moves target the biggest profit leaks: lost sales from stock‑outs and inefficient ad spend, while leveraging your owned channel for higher margin. Let me know if you’d like a quick reorder template or ad‑performance check‑list! ✨

Stock left: 44 pieces worth MYR 1,408 at cost (bought 65). Ads MYR 1,800, about MYR 115 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 578. Costs MYR 9,935, net -MYR 2,267. Cash now MYR 15k. Shop rating 4.46. This month's big sale is the 1.1 New Year sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your December data shows strong demand — you turned away ~72 potential orders due to stockouts, especially on fast-movers like satin dresses (+29), linen sets (+23), scarves (+26), and blazers (+5). Meanwhile, slow-moving pleated skirts tie up capital without selling. Your ad spend drove orders at ~MYR 115 per order — close to your AOV, suggesting low marginal return. To boost profit this month, fix inventory flow, sharpen ad efficiency, and leverage the 1.1 sale to convert interest while clearing dead stock.

1. **Restock top sellers based on lost demand**: Immediately reorder enough satin wrap dresses (30 units), linen co-ord sets (25), silk scarves (30), and tailored blazers (10) to cover December’s unmet demand. At current cost, that’s ~MYR 2,100. Prioritize these over skirts — they deliver 50–69% profit per unit after fees and move fast.  
2. **Audit and cut inefficient ad spend**: Pull ad performance by platform and creative. Pause any ad set with cost per order > MYR 90 (below your AOR). Redirect savings to UGC-style TikTok content featuring real customers — your Livestream peaked at 86 viewers, showing organic reach works. Target ≤ MYR 70/order via better targeting and creatives.  
3. **Bundle slow stock with bestsellers for the 1.1 sale**: Create a “New Year Refresh” bundle: 1 pleated midi skirt (normally MYR 89) + 1 silk scarf (MYR 39) = MYR 128 value, sell for MYR 99 on your website (2% fee) and TikTok (9% fee). Promote it as “limited stock” in your 1.1 sale posts. This clears slow inventory while boosting AOV and moving stock with minimal margin loss. Track sell-through weekly.  

These steps turn demand into revenue, reduce wasted ad spend, and use the sale strategically — all critical to hit MYR 8,800/month for Level 4. Ready to track results? Let me know if you’d like a simple sheet to monitor restock arrival vs. lost sales. ✨

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of April 2027. Last month: 2027-03: sales MYR 14k from 116 orders (69 new, 47 repeat), average order MYR 123. Stock left: 121 pieces worth MYR 5,728 at cost (bought 189). Ads MYR 0. Platform fees MYR 1,026. Costs MYR 15k, net -MYR 457. Cash now MYR 13k. Shop rating 4.51. This month's big sale is the Post-Raya clearance. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Your biggest drain is high costs relative to revenue—last month’s MYR 15k spend versus MYR 14k sales gave a MYR 457 loss. To flip that, focus on lifting margin per sale and trimming waste.

1. Raise average order value to MYR 130+ by bundling slow movers: create a “Post-Raya Clearance Bundle” – pleated midi skirt (MYR 89) + silk-touch scarf (MYR 39) at a bundled price MYR 100 (instead of MYR 128). Sell via TikTok Live and website pop‑up; target 30 bundles → extra MYR 300 revenue, clears ~30 skirts (~MYR 960 cost tied up) and 30 scarves (~MYR 360 cost).  
2. Cut platform fees by shifting 40% of March’s 116 orders (≈46 orders) from Shopee/TikTok to your own website (fee drops from avg 11.5% to 2.9% + MYR 1/order). At MYR 123 AOV, save ≈MYR 414 in fees this month (46 × (MYR 14.15 – MYR 4.57)).  
3. Trim variable stock cost: negotiate a 5% discount with your tailor on next reorder (current fabric/trim cost ~MYR 52–66 per piece). On a typical MYR 8k monthly stock buy, that saves MYR 400, directly boosting gross profit.

Implement these three actions; together they should swing March’s –MYR 457 net into a MYR +300–500 range, moving you toward the MYR 8.8k monthly profit needed for Level 4. Track weekly via a simple spreadsheet (sales, orders, fees, stock spend) to see impact fast. 🌟
